target: Dated, independently verified restaurant-operation and permanent-closure intervals
validation: Training openings and known labels strictly before cutoff; future openings in SHA256(NTA) mod 5 held-out spatial groups
baseline: Training-fold-only constant log-normal AFT; scale fixed to model scale
ablation: Remove each historical predictor in turn; same fold, rounds and parameters; no test-selected feature set
deployment_policy: No automatic promotion from an engineering test or an uncalibrated scenario
limitation: The post-2024 holdout cannot establish complete 3-year follow-up by 2026-10-27. Report unresolved cases; do not classify them as survivors. Empirical training still requires the evidence contract.
